result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where the bottom navigation bar collides with the system home indicator due to missing safe-area insets.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar lacks bottom safe-area padding, causing the system home indicator bar to directly overlap the Search and Orders icons while pushing all navigation icons flush against the bottom edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Apply bottom safe-area inset padding (e.g., `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`) to the bottom navigation bar container so the icons sit comfortably above the system home indicator.
